results.title: Scotland vs Ivory Coast Prediction and Betting Tips | March 31st 2026
highlights:
Scotland and Ivory Coast continue their preparations for the upcoming FIFA World Cup when they lock horns in an international friendly at Hill Dickinson Stadium on Tuesday. Both sides picked up contrasting results at the weekend, with Les Elephants claiming a dominant victory over South Korea.
[...]
Scotland kicked off their friendly preparations for the World Cup on a sour note last weekend when they fell to a 1-0 defeat at the hands of Japan.
[...]
This followed a solid run in the World Cup qualifiers, where they picked up four wins and one draw from their six games in Group C to clinch top spot and an automatic ticket to the global tournament.
[...]
Scotland will follow Tuesday’s tie with their final warm-up game against Curacao on May 30, before taking on Haiti in the Group C opener of the World Cup on June 14.
[...]
On the other hand, Ivory Coast turned in a solid team display last Saturday, when they cruised to a 4-0 victory over South Korea at Stadium MK.
[...]
This followed a somewhat disappointing run in the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations, where Les Elephants crashed out in the quarter-finals courtesy of a narrow 3-2 loss against record champions Egypt.
[...]
Ivory Coast have been drawn in Group E of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, alongside Ecuador, four-time champions Germany, and debutants Curacao.
[...]
## Scotland vs Ivory Coast Head-To-Head and Key Numbers
[...]
- This will be the very first meeting between Scotland and the Ivory Coast, and both nations will look to begin their rivalry on a positive note.
- Ivory Coast are unbeaten in eight of their most recent nine friendly outings, picking up six victories and one draw since March 2024.
- Scotland have won just two of their last nine friendly matches since September 2023, while losing six and claiming one draw in that time.
- Ivory Coast are unbeaten in six of their most recent eight away games across all competitions, picking up five wins and one draw since June 2025.
[...]
## Scotland vs Ivory Coast Prediction
[...]
Scotland and the Ivory Coast are expected to name a shuffled XI on Tuesday, but we expect both sides to be up for the challenge at the Hill Dickinson Stadium.
[...]
Ivory Coast are unbeaten in six of their last seven matches in all competitions, and we are backing them to come out on top in a thrilling contest.
[...]
Prediction: Scotland 1-2 Ivory Coast
[...]
## Scotland vs Ivory Coast Betting Tips
[...]
Tip 1: Result - Ivory Coast to win
[...]
Tip 2: Over 2.5 goals - Yes (There have been three or more goals scored in four of Scotland’s last five outings)
[...]
Tip 3: Both sides to score - Yes (Both sides have also scored in four of Scotland's last five games)

results.title: Scotland vs Ivory Coast Predictions: Backing a score tie in Liverpool | Goal.com US
highlights:
We’re backing a tie as the Scots face the Ivorians. They should cancel each other out at Hill Dickinson Stadium.
[...]
### Our analysis: Form of both teams
[...]
- Score prediction - Scotland 1-1 Ivory Coast
- Goalscorers prediction - Scotland: Scott McTominay - Ivory Coast: Evann Guessand
[...]
Last year was a big one for Scotland. Steve Clarke’s men picked up six wins from 10 matches. The Tartan Army must be pleased with that return. World Cup qualification proved to be the cherry on top. They may have started 2026 with a defeat to Japan, but they’ll be eager to bounce back.
[...]
As for Ivory Coast, they suffered Africa Cup of Nations disappointment earlier this year after losing to Egypt in the quarter-finals. Emerse Faé’s side have proven very difficult to beat, with just three losses in their last 16 games. A 4-0 hammering of South Korea over the weekend has likely been a huge boost ahead of this summer’s World Cup.
[...]
Both Scotland and Ivory Coast hope to make their mark at the 2026 World Cup this summer. This game serves as an important warm-up fixture for the two sides, and neither wants to suffer defeat. With that in mind, we can see them playing out a tie in Liverpool.
[...]
This will be the first meeting between the two nations, so there’s no head-to-head record to look back on. With plenty of players playing for their places, this clash will be an opportunity to prove their worth. It should be a very interesting match-up, but ultimately we expect a close affair to end level.
[...]
